verdict.rationale: Smooth markets stealth-adjacent features such as auto-CAPTCHA solvers and proxies for scraping, so an acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no published acceptable-use, terms-of-service, or anti-abuse document governing how those features may be used. Community comments only note the aggressive marketing and the absence of security documentation; they do not point to any such policy.
